title: Its not a journal ( said in Arnold voice)
author: Character_Cod_5767
selftext:
\​

WorkTree-OS started because I was tired of having my trades in one place, analytics somewhere else, spreadsheets everywhere, and still not having a clear answer to the questions that actually matter:

Am I profitable because I have an edge or because I got lucky?

How much risk can my strategy actually handle?

What happens to my account when the losing streak comes?

Can this strategy survive a prop-firm drawdown?

That’s what WorkTree-OS is being built to answer.

This is NOT just another trading journal.

WorkTree-OS is a trading analytics and risk platform built around your actual trade data.

Import your trades and start digging into:

• Detailed performance analytics

• Win rate, P&L, expectancy and trade counts

• Calendar and session performance

• Risk analysis

• Monte Carlo simulations

• Prop-firm account simulations

• Consistency analysis

• Strategy and setup breakdowns

• Account tracking

• Trade journaling

• Atlas — the WorkTree-OS AI Coach

The goal is simple:

Stop guessing. Start proving.

A 70% win rate sounds great — but was it 7 trades or 700?

A strategy making money today sounds great — but what happens across thousands of simulated account paths?

Could your strategy survive the drawdown rules on a funded account?

Which session actually makes you money?

Which setup is carrying your account — and which one is quietly killing it?

WorkTree-OS is being built to make those answers obvious.

And I’m building it as an actual trader. I’m using the same platform myself, finding what sucks, fixing it, adding what traders actually need, and improving it constantly.

I’M LOOKING FOR EARLY USERS.

I don't need people to tell me everything looks pretty.

I want traders who will import real data, beat on the platform, find problems, challenge the analytics, and tell me what would make it better.

And I'm rewarding the people willing to get in early.

The first 25 early users get 6 MONTHS of Pro access FREE, plus a 25% founder discount for life on eligible paid tiers.

No promises of Lambos.

No magic indicator.

No signals.

No bullshit.

Just your trades, your numbers, and tools designed to tell you the truth about your trading.

WorkTree-OS

Your trades. Your data. Your edge.

worktree-os.com

If you're serious about understanding your trading instead of just staring at your P&L, check it out.

And if you get in early, I WANT your feedback. You're not just testing another trading journal — you're helping shape what WorkTree-OS becomes.
